simple.meaning: יָקֹשׁ (yâqôsh) is a Hebrew word meaning “to ensnare (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יָקֹשׁ (H3369) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 7:25, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Isaiah, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָקֹשׁ (H3369) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יָקֹשׁ (H3369) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יָקֹשׁ (yâqôsh) / H3369 is traced through Deuteronomy 7:25, Psalms 124:7, Psalms 141:9, Proverbs 6:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare.
Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me,
you are trapped by the words of your mouth;

For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

Therefore Yahweh’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.
I have laid a snare for you,

definitions.full: H3369. yaqosh [ יָקשׁ ] verb lay a bait or lure (see מוֺקֵשׁ ), then Generally lay snares (see also קוֺשׁ נקשׁ, ) — Qal Perfect יָק֫שְׁתִּי Jer 50:24 ; יָָֽקְשׁוּ Psa 141:9 ; Participle plural יוֺקְשִׁים 124:7 ; — lay snares , figurative of devices of wicked 141:9 (with accusative of congnate meaning with verb); of ׳י s plan to destroy Babylon Jer 50:24 נלכדר וגם לך יקשׁתי ; Participle as substantive bait-layers, fowlers Psa 124:7 (compare 141:9 ) simile Niph`al Perfect נוֺקַ֫שְׁתָּ Prov 6:2 ; וְנוֺקְשׁוּ consecutive Isa 8:15 ; 28:13 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּוָּקֵשׁ Deut 7:25 ; be caught by a bait, ensnared , in business entanglements Prov 6:2 ; in disastrous consequences of idolatry Deut 7:25 (|| נלכד ); of those ensnared by ׳י s plans (followed by ונלכדו ) Isa 8:15 ; 28:13 . Pu`al Participle יוּקָשִׁים (for מְיוּקָשִׁים , unless this should be read: Ges § 52 . R. 6; Sta § 220 ): entrapped , in circumstances of life Eccl 9:12 .
